name: Lucena
queryOutcomes: English and Tagalog discovery queries were executed and recorded in the city record. Official Quezon assessor, Lucena city, Geoportal Philippines, and DENR-LMB FOI pages were inspected. No Lucena parcel viewer/API or bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was verified.
requestOutcomes: Public HTTPS GET requests to the official assessor, city, Geoportal and lot-plotter pages returned usable page evidence. A bounded ArcGIS catalog search returned no verified Lucena parcel service. No credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe attributes, or TLS exceptions were used.
officialCustodian: Quezon Provincial Assessor's Office is evidenced as a local/provincial cadastral and tax-map custodian. Its page states that the Tax Mapping Operations Division prepares and maintains cadastral/tax/index maps, scans cadastral maps, assigns Property Index Numbers, and provides tax-map verification/issuance. This is not source integration or admission.
scopeLimits: No public Lucena parcel layer or API was identified.
No exact-point hit or map extent was tested because no usable parcel endpoint was established.
The official lot-plotter is a survey-input visualization tool, not evidence of parcel coverage.
Search/catalog non-discovery does not establish citywide absence.
uncertainty: No geometry was retained. Runtime remains held pending independent serial qualification of a real open adapter and geographically scoped native IDs.
artifactsNotWritten: no GeoJSON sample; no verified parcel polygon
